name: Acolyte

equipment.item: a prayer book or prayer wheel

feature_description: You command the respect of those who share your faith and can perform the religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your companions can receive free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith (you provide any material components for spells). Those who share your religion support you (but only you) at a modest lifestyle. You may also have ties to a specific temple, with a residence there; while near it you can call on the priests for assistance, provided it is not hazardous and you remain in good standing.

name: Anthropologist
feature_description: You can communicate with humanoids who don't speak any language you know. You must observe the humanoids interacting with one another for at least 1 day, after which you learn a handful of important words, expressions, and gestures, enough to communicate on a rudimentary level. (Also includes the Cultural Chameleon trait: choose or roll the culture you adopted.)

equipment.item: A bronze discus or leather ball
a lucky charm or past trophy

feature_description: When visiting any settlement within 100 miles of where you grew up, there is a 50 percent chance you can find someone who admires you and is willing to provide information or temporary shelter. Between adventures, you can compete in athletic events sufficient to maintain a comfortable lifestyle, as per the "Practicing a Profession" downtime activity.

name: Azorius Functionary

equipment.item: a scroll containing the text of a law important to you
and a belt pouch containing 10 gp (Azorius-minted 1-zino coins)

feature_description: You have the authority to enforce the laws of Ravnica, which inspires respect and even fear. People mind their manners around you and assume you have the right to be wherever you are. Showing your Azorius insignia gets you an audience with anyone you want to talk to. If you abuse this privilege you can get in serious trouble or be stripped of your position.

name: Black Fist Double Agent

tool_proficiencies.name: and one type of artisan's tools or gaming set

equipment.item: a writ of free agency signed by the Lord Regent
a set of artisan's tools or gaming set you are proficient with

feature_description: You have a reliable contact within the Tears of Virulence garrison in Phlan to whom you pass information, and in exchange you can get away with minor criminal offenses within the town of Phlan. Your Black Fists contacts can also help you secure an audience with the Lord Regent, the Lord Sage, members of the Black Fists, or deposed nobles and authority figures sympathetic to the Phlan refugees and insurgents.

name: Boros Legionnaire

equipment.item: a feather from an angel's wing
a tattered piece of a Boros banner
and a belt pouch containing 2 gp (Boros-minted 1-zino coins)

feature_description: You have an established place in the hierarchy of the Boros Legion. You can requisition simple equipment for temporary use and gain access to any Boros garrison in Ravnica, where you can rest in safety and receive the attention of medics. You are also paid 1 gp per week, which with free lodging lets you maintain a poor lifestyle between adventures.

name: Caravan Specialist

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 10 gp

feature_description: Others look to you for direction when a situation gets serious. You can identify the most defensible locations for camping. If you are part of a caravan outfit, you can attract two additional workers loyal to you based on your reputation. You have an excellent memory for maps and geography and can always determine your cardinal directions while traveling.

name: Celebrity Adventurer's Scion

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 30 gp

feature_description: You know and have met any number of powerful people, and some might remember you. You might be able to wrangle minor assistance from a major figure in the campaign, at the DM's discretion. Common folk treat you with deference, and your heritage and stories might be good for a free meal or a place to sleep.

equipment.item: tools of the con of your choice (ten stoppered bottles filled with colored liquid
or a signet ring of an imaginary duke)

feature_description: You have created a second identity that includes documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises that allow you to assume that persona. skill_proficiencies.name: Insight (Investigator variant: Investigation instead of Athletics)

equipment.item: A uniform in the style of your unit and indicative of your rank
a horn with which to summon help

feature_description: Your experience enforcing the law gives you a feel for local laws and criminals. You can easily find the local outpost of the watch or a similar organization, and just as easily pick out the dens of criminal activity in a community, although you're more likely to be welcome in the former.

equipment.item: A set of artisan's tools with which you are proficient
and a pouch containing 5 gp and a gem worth 10 gp

feature_description: You always have free room and board in any place where shield dwarves or gold dwarves dwell, and individuals in such a settlement might vie to offer you (and possibly your companions) the finest accommodations and assistance.

skill_proficiencies.name: plus your choice of one from among Arcana

equipment.item: The scholar's robes of your cloister
a writing kit (small pouch with a quill
a borrowed book on the subject of your current study

feature_description: You have free and easy access to the majority of your library, though it may have repositories of lore too valuable, magical, or secret for immediate access. You know your cloister's personnel and bureaucracy and how to navigate it, and are likely to gain preferential treatment at other libraries across the Realms as professional courtesy.

equipment.item: a small cast-off scale belonging to Vorgansharax
and a pouch with 5 gp of various coins

This affords you fame and notoriety: nobles, scholars, mages, and others keen to hear your tale grant you and your companions access to people and places you might not otherwise have. It also makes it difficult to disguise your appearance and hide.

languages.name: One of your choice of Elvish

feature_description: Your mannerisms and knowledge of fey customs are recognized by natives of the Feywild, who see you as one of their own. Friendly Fey creatures are inclined to come to your aid if you are lost or need help in the Feywild.

options.description: Your eyes swirl with iridescent colors.
You have a sweet scent, like that of nectar or honey.
You have long whiskers like those of a cat.
Your ears are covered with soft tufts of fur.
Your skin sparkles in moonlight.
Flowers either bloom or wilt (your choice) in your presence.
Your hair is made of vines or brambles and grows back to normal length within 1 hour of being cut.

name: Fisher

equipment.item: a favorite fishing lure or oiled leather wading boots
and a belt pouch containing 10 gp

feature_description: You gain advantage on ability checks made using fishing tackle. If you have access to a body of water that sustains marine life, you can maintain a moderate lifestyle as a fisher and catch enough food to feed yourself and up to ten other people each day. (Also includes Fishing Tale: once a day, tell a story to willing listeners, some of whom may become friendly toward you at the DM's discretion.)

options.description: Lobster Wrestling: You fought in hand-to-hand combat with an immense lobster.
It Dragged the Boat: You nearly caught a fish of monstrous size that pulled your boat for miles.
Fins of Pure Gold: You caught a sea animal whose fins were made of pure gold, but another fisher stole it.
Ghost Fish: You are haunted by a ghostly fish that only you can see.
Nemesis Clam: A large clam containing a pearl the size of your head claimed one of your fingers before jetting away; one day, you'll find that clam.
It Swallowed the Sun: You once saw a fish leap from the water and turn day into night.
Dive into the Abyss: You found yourself in an underwater cave leading to the Abyss, and your luck has been sour ever since.
Love Story: You fell in love with a creature of pure water, but your brief romance ended tragically.

name: Folk Hero

equipment.item: A set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)

feature_description: You fit in easily among common folk. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

I saved people during a natural disaster.
I stood alone against a terrible monster.
I stole from a corrupt merchant to help the poor.

name: Gambler

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 15 gp

feature_description: During downtime activities involving games of chance or figuring odds on the best plan, you get a solid sense of which choice is likely best and which opportunities seem too good to be true, at the DM's determination.

feature_name: Red Plume and Mage Guild Contacts
feature_description: Your friends among the Red Plumes and the Mage's Guild help you in little ways. In and around Hillsfar you can invoke their assistance to obtain food and simple equipment for temporary use, and to gain access to low-security areas of their garrisons, halls, and encampments.

equipment.item: A ring of keys to unknown locks

feature_description: You gain the Scion of the Outer Planes feat. You also know where to find free, modest lodging and food in the community you grew up in.

equipment.item: a small stone or sprig that reminds you of home

feature_description: You gain the Strike of the Giants feat.

options.description: You were found as a baby by a family of nomadic giants who raised you as one of their own.
A family of stone giants rescued you when you fell into a mountain crag, and you have lived with them underground ever since.
You were lost or abandoned as a child in a jungle that teemed with ravenous dinosaurs. There, you found an equally lost frost giant and together, you survived.
Your farm was crushed and your family killed in a battle between warring groups of giants. Racked with guilt, a sympathetic giant soldier promised to care for you.
After a series of strange dreams as a child, your superstitious parents sent you to study with a powerful but aloof storm giant oracle.
While playing hide-and-seek with your friends, you stumbled into the castle of a cloud giant matriarch, who immediately adopted you.

name: Golgari Agent

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 10 gp worth of mixed coins

feature_description: You know hidden, underground pathways. When not in combat, you and companions you lead can travel between any two locations in the city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow. The paths are haunted by dangers, so the journey isn't guaranteed to be safe.

equipment.item: a musical instrument of your choice
a gold-plated ring depicting a smiling face

feature_description: In any city of 10,000 people or more on the Menagerie Coast or in the Dwendalian Empire, you can play the "Ballad of a Grinning Fool" in any major tavern or inn. A member of the Golden Grin will find you and give shelter to you and any companions you vouch for. Shelter may be discontinued if it becomes too dangerous, and not all who know the ballad are friends.

options.description: Zan's Coming Back. Hopeful Tal'Dorei folk song declaring the return of a just ruler. Use it to seek out potential allies.
Blow Fire Down the Coast. Rowdy Clovis Concord fighting song about blasting pirate ships. Use it to encourage battle.
Hush! Onward Come the Dragons. Tal'Dorei folk song recounting terror after the Crimson King's invasion. Use it to encourage caution in speech and deed.
Let the Sword Grow Rust. Antiwar anthem from Marquet. Use it to help quell violent encounters.
Drink Deep, Li'l Hummingbird. Menagerie Coast drinking rondo about a youth who wakes as a stowaway. Use it to encourage alertness in social situations.
Dirge for the Emerald Fire. Elven song with thousands of obscure verses. Use the first two verses to spread news of death and defeat.

name: Gruul Anarch

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 10 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

feature_description: You are familiar with ruined neighborhoods, overgrown parks, and rubblebelts that most people shun. You can find a suitable place for you and your allies to hide or rest there, and find food and fresh water in these areas for yourself and up to five other people each day.

description: Those who look into your eyes can see you have faced unimaginable horror. Though they might fear you, commoners will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they will even take up arms to fight alongside you if you face an enemy alone.

options.description: A monster that slaughtered dozens of innocent people spared your life, and you don't know why.
You were born under a dark star. You can feel it watching you, coldly and distantly. Sometimes it beckons you in the dead of night.
An apparition that has haunted your family for generations now haunts you. You don't know what it wants, and it won't leave you alone.
Your family has a history of practicing the dark arts. You dabbled once and felt something horrible clutch at your soul, whereupon you fled in terror.
An oni took your sibling one cold, dark night, and you were unable to stop it.
You were cursed with lycanthropy and later cured. You are now haunted by the innocents you slaughtered.
A hag kidnapped and raised you. You escaped, but the hag still has a magical hold over you and fills your mind with evil thoughts.
You opened an eldritch tome and saw things unfit for a sane mind. You burned the book, but its words and images are burned into your psyche.
A fiend possessed you as a child. You were locked away but escaped. The fiend is still inside you, but now you try to keep it locked away.
You did terrible things to avenge the murder of someone you loved. You became a monster, and it haunts your waking dreams.

name: Hermit

equipment.item: A scroll case stuffed full of notes from your studies or prayers

feature_description: The quiet seclusion of your hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery (a great truth about the cosmos, a site no one else has seen, a forgotten fact, or a relic that could rewrite history). Work with your DM to determine its details and impact on the campaign.
description: The quiet seclusion of your hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery (a great truth about the cosmos, a site no one else has seen, a forgotten fact, or a relic that could rewrite history). Work with your DM to determine its details and impact on the campaign.

options.description: I was searching for spiritual enlightenment.
I was partaking of communal living in accordance with the dictates of a religious order.
I was exiled for a crime I didn't commit.
I retreated from society after a life-altering event.
I needed a quiet place to work on my art, literature, music, or manifesto.
I needed to commune with nature, far from civilization.
I was the caretaker of an ancient ruin or relic.
I was a pilgrim in search of a person, place, or relic of spiritual significance.

name: Hillsfar Merchant

equipment.item: a letter of introduction from your family's trading house

feature_description: Your family has assigned you a loyal retainer (a factor, husbanding agent, seafarer, caravan guard, or clerk), a commoner who performs mundane tasks like purchases, messages, and errands. He or she won't fight or follow you into obviously dangerous areas, and leaves if frequently endangered or abused; if killed, the family assigns another within a few days. Alternate feature, Trade Contact: once per game session in the Moonsea region or along the Sword Coast, use trade contacts to get local information or pass a message to someone in those areas.

name: Hillsfar Smuggler
feature_description: You can call on smuggling contacts to secure secret passage into or out of Hillsfar for yourself and your companions, no questions asked. Since you're calling in a favor, the DM determines whether you can be smuggled; you might owe the Rogues Guild a favor and/or have to pay bribes.

feature_description: You can always get food and lodging for yourself and your friends at a house enclave. When the house assigns a mission it usually provides supplies and transportation. You have old friends, mentors, and rivals in your house, and how willing they are to help depends on your current standing.

tool_proficiencies.name: Your choice of a gaming set or a musical instrument

equipment.item: the tool you choose for this background's tool proficiency (gaming set or musical instrument)

feature_description: You are the heir to an object entrusted to you alone. Choose or roll your inheritance and work with the DM on its details. The DM determines its properties (it might be a minor magic item, grow in potency, or reveal its true nature only when conditions are met) and may use it as a story hook. You can choose whether to tell your companions about it.

name: Initiate

equipment.item: a scroll containing the basic teachings of the five gods
and a belt pouch containing 15 gp (plus any cartouches earned from completed trials)

feature_description: While you prepare for and undergo the trials, you have constant access to training, plus a comfortable place to live and regular meals provided by servitor mummies under the supervision of viziers. These benefits last only while you obey Naktamun's societal norms; violating them risks being treated as a dissenter.

tool_proficiencies.name: one set of artisan's tools of your choice

equipment.item: and a belt pouch containing 15 gp

feature_description: As an inquisitor of the church you have the authority to arrest criminals, and in the absence of other authorities you may pass judgment and carry out sentencing. If you abuse this power, your superiors might strip it from you.
description: As an inquisitor of the church you have the authority to arrest criminals, and in the absence of other authorities you may pass judgment and carry out sentencing. If you abuse this power, your superiors might strip it from you.

name: Investigator

equipment.item: evidence from a past case (choose one or roll for a trinket from the Horror Trinkets table)

feature_description: Through fast-talking, determination, and official-looking documentation, you can gain access to a place or individual related to a crime you're investigating. Those not involved avoid impeding you or pass along your requests. Local law enforcement views you as either a nuisance or one of their own.
description: Through fast-talking, determination, and official-looking documentation, you can gain access to a place or individual related to a crime you're investigating. options.description: A friend was wrongfully accused of murder. You tracked down the actual killer, proving your friend's innocence and starting your career as a detective.
You're told you went missing for weeks. When you were found, you had no memory of being gone. Now you search to discover what happened to you.
You helped a spirit find peace by finding its missing corpse. Ever since, other spectral clients have sought you out to help them find rest.
You revealed that the monsters terrorizing your home were illusions created by a cruel mage. The magic-user escaped, but you've continued to uncover magical hoaxes.
You were wrongfully accused and convicted of a crime. You escaped and seek to help others avoid the experience you suffered, even while still pursued by the law.
You survived the destructive use of a magic device that wiped out your home. Members of a secret organization found you and you now track dangerous supernatural phenomena with them.
You found evidence of a conspiracy underpinning society. You tried to expose this cabal, but no one believed you. You're still trying to prove what you know is true.
You got a job with an agency that investigates crimes local law enforcement can't solve. You often wonder which you value more, the truth or your pay.

name: Iron Route Bandit

equipment.item: A set of dark common clothes
burglar's pack and a belt pouch containing 5 gp

feature_description: You know people always looking for stolen animals and vehicles. They tell you which animals and vehicles are in high demand in the area, and offer favors and information (DM's choice) if you bring them such animals and vehicles.
description: You know people always looking for stolen animals and vehicles. They tell you which animals and vehicles are in high demand in the area, and offer favors and information (DM's choice) if you bring them such animals and vehicles.

equipment.item: the charred and twisted remains of a failed experiment
and a belt pouch containing 5 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

feature_description: You have basic knowledge of the structure of buildings, including the stuff behind the walls, and can find blueprints of a specific building to learn entry points, structural weaknesses, or secret spaces. If obtaining or using this information gets you in trouble with the law, the guild can't shield you.

tool_proficiencies.name: Your choice of a gaming set or a musical instrument

equipment.item: or seal representing your place or rank in the order

feature_description: You receive shelter and succor from members of your order and those sympathetic to its aims (religious orders: temples of your deity; civic orders: the community served; philosophical orders: those aided or sharing the ideals). This includes shelter, meals, healing, and occasionally risky assistance such as locals rallying to a pressed knight or smuggling a hunted knight out of town.

name: Lorehold Student
feature_description: You gain the Strixhaven Initiate feat and must choose Lorehold within it. If you have Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the Lorehold spells (1st: Comprehend Languages, Identify; 2nd: Borrowed Knowledge, Locate Object; 3rd: Speak With Dead, Spirit Guardians; 4th: Arcane Eye, Stone Shape; 5th: Flame Strike, Legend Lore) are added to your class spell list.

name: Marine

equipment.item: A dagger that belonged to a fallen comrade
a folded flag emblazoned with the symbol of your ship or company
and a belt pouch containing 10 gp

feature_description: You can move twice the normal amount of time (up to 16 hours) each day before being subject to the effect of a forced march. You can also automatically find a safe route to land a boat on shore, provided such a route exists.
description: You can move twice the normal amount of time (up to 16 hours) each day before being subject to the effect of a forced march. You can also automatically find a safe route to land a boat on shore, provided such a route exists.

options.description: Nearly Drowned: You hid underwater to avoid detection and held your breath for an extremely long time. Just before you would have died, you had a revelation about your existence.
Captured: You spent months enduring thirst, starvation, and torture at the hands of your enemy, but you never broke.
Sacrifice: You enabled the escape of your fellow soldiers, but at great cost to yourself. Some of your past comrades may think you're dead.
Juggernaut: No reasonable explanation can explain how you survived a particular battle. Every arrow and bolt missed you. You slew scores of enemies single-handedly and led your comrades to victory.
Stowaway: For days, you hid in the bilge of an enemy ship, surviving on brackish water and foolhardy rats. At the right moment, you crept up to the deck and took over the ship on your own.
Leave None Behind: You carried an injured marine for miles to avoid capture and death.

name: Mercenary Veteran

equipment.item: A uniform of your company (traveler's clothes in quality)
a gaming set of your choice
and a pouch containing the remainder of your last wages (10 gp)

feature_description: You can identify mercenary companies by their emblems and know a little about any such company, including who has hired them recently. You can find the taverns and festhalls where mercenaries abide in any area, as long as you speak the language, and can find mercenary work between adventures sufficient to maintain a comfortable lifestyle.

tool_proficiencies.name: One type of artistic artisan's tools and one musical instrument

equipment.item: One set of artisan's tools or musical instrument

feature_description: Every other class of citizen in Mulmaster defers to you, even the priesthood, Soldiery, Hawks, and Cloaks. Other aristocrats and nobles accept you in their circles and likely know you or of you. Your connections can get you the ear of a Zor or Zora under the right circumstances.

name: Noble
feature_description: People are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. Common folk accommodate you and avoid your displeasure, other nobles treat you as one of their own, and you can secure an audience with a local noble. (Variant feature: Retainers, three loyal commoner retainers who won't fight or enter obviously dangerous areas.)

feature_description: You can exert leverage over individuals below you in the guild's hierarchy and demand their help (carrying a message, a free carriage ride, cleaning up a mess). The DM determines schedule and travel time, and you are expected to assist the crew. feature_description: Provided you have carpenter's tools and wood, you can repair a water vehicle, restoring hull hit points equal to 5 x your proficiency modifier. A vehicle can't be patched this way again until it has been pulled ashore and fully repaired.

options.description: Grand Designs: You are working on plans for a new, very fast ship. You must examine as many different kinds of vessels as possible to help ensure its success.
Solid and Sound: You patched up a war galley and prevented it from sinking. The local navy regards you as a friend.
Favored: You insisted on thicker planking for a merchant vessel's hull, which saved it when it smashed against a reef. You have a standing invitation to visit the merchant's distant mansion.
Master of Armaments: You specialized in designing and mounting defenses for the navy. You easily recognize and determine the quality of such items.
Low Places: You have contacts in smuggling outfits along the coast; you occasionally repair criminals' ships in exchange for coin and favors.
Mysteries of the Deep: You encountered a possibly divine being while sailing alone. Work with your DM to determine the secret about the deep waters it revealed to you.

equipment.item: A fancy leather vest or a pair of leather boots
and a leather pouch with 15 gp

feature_description: You know a network of smugglers willing to help you out of tight situations. In a town, city, or similarly sized community (DM's discretion), you and your companions can stay for free in safe houses (poor lifestyle), and can choose to keep your presence secret.
description: You know a network of smugglers willing to help you out of tight situations. In a town, city, or similarly sized community (DM's discretion), you and your companions can stay for free in safe houses (poor lifestyle), and can choose to keep your presence secret.

options.description: Spirit of the Whale: You smuggled stolen dwarven spirits in the body of a dead whale being pulled behind a fishing boat. When you delivered the goods, the corpse exploded, sending whale meat and whiskey bottles for half a mile.
Cart and Sword: You drove a cart filled with stolen art through the middle of a battlefield while singing sea shanties to confuse the combatants.
The Recruit: You enlisted in another nation's navy to smuggle stolen jewels to a distant port. You attained a minor rank before disappearing from the navy.
River of Shadows: Your riverboat accidentally slipped through the veil into the Shadowfell for several hours, where you sold stolen dragonborn artifacts before returning to this plane.
Gold-Hearted: You agreed to transport a family escaping a war. When the baby cried at a checkpoint, you gave the guards all your gold to let you pass. The family never found out.
Playing Both Sides: You smuggled crates of crossbow bolts and bundles of arrows, each destined for an opposing side in a regional war, at the same time, and the buyers never discovered your trickery.

name: Soldier

equipment.item: a trophy taken from a fallen enemy (a dagger
a bone dice set or playing card set

feature_description: Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and defer to you if they are of lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers, requisition simple equipment or horses for temporary use, and usually gain access to friendly military encampments and fortresses.

name: Stojanow Prisoner

equipment.item: a trinket from the life you stayed behind to defend

feature_description: Your time in prison gives you insight into local guards and jailors; you know which will accept bribes or look the other way. You can also seek shelter from the authorities with other criminals in the area.

name: Ticklebelly Nomad

equipment.item: a small article of jewelry distinct to your tribe
and a belt pouch containing 5 gp

feature_description: You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate in the wild that is secure enough to conceal you from most natural threats. Supernatural, magical, or actively hunting threats may find you with difficulty depending on their nature (DM's call), and the feature doesn't shield you from scrying, mental probing, or threats that don't require the five senses.

name: Trade Sheriff
feature_description: You can invoke your rank to access a crime scene or requisition equipment or horses temporarily. When you enter a town or village around Hillsfar you can identify a contact who will give you local rumors and help you because of your desire to get answers for anyone wanting to disrupt trade.

name: Urban Bounty Hunter

tool_proficiencies.name: Choose two from among one type of gaming set

equipment.item: A set of clothes appropriate to your duties and a pouch containing 20 gp

feature_description: You are in frequent contact with people in the segment of society your quarries move through (criminal underworld, street folk, or high society). In any city you visit you have a contact who provides information about the people and places of the local area.

name: Urchin

equipment.item: a map of the city you grew up in
a token to remember your parents by

feature_description: You know the secret patterns and flow of cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl that others would miss. When not in combat, you (and companions you lead) can travel between any two locations in the city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow.

name: Uthgardt Tribe Member

tool_proficiencies.name: One type of musical instrument or artisan's tools

equipment.item: a totemic token or set of tattoos marking your loyalty to Uthgar and your tribal totem

feature_description: You know your tribe's territory and the terrain and natural resources of the rest of the North, and can find twice as much food and water as normal when foraging in any wilderness area. You can also call on the hospitality of your people and their allies (druid circles, nomadic elves, the Harpers, priesthoods of the First Circle).

name: Vizier

equipment.item: A set of artisan's tools or a musical instrument (one of your choice)
a scroll of your god's teachings

feature_description: Your voice is the voice of your god. Initiates are expected to defer to you and obey your commands, and you may train and instruct them. If you abuse this authority, your god might personally punish you.

name: Volstrucker Agent

equipment.item: a black cloak with a hood

feature_description: You can communicate with other Volstrucker over long distances: write a letter in special arcane ink (10 gp per page), address it to a member, and cast it into fire; it burns to cinders and materializes whole on the addressee.
description: You can communicate with other Volstrucker over long distances: write a letter in special arcane ink (10 gp per page), address it to a member, and cast it into fire; it burns to cinders and materializes whole on the addressee.

options.description: Familicide. Through deceit or manipulation, the Volstrucker convinced you to slaughter your own family.
Amnesia. You were forced to study magic so potent that it strained your mind beyond its mortal limits, stealing away the memories of your past.
Capture. You were captured and tortured by agents of the Kryn Dynasty, and barely escaped.
Starvation. A terrible blight afflicted your rural village, and many friends and family starved to death. You barely survived.
Disfigurement. One of your arcane experiments went wrong and scarred or dismembered you so gravely that others shun you. Only the Volstrucker showed you kindness after that day.
Vicissitude. You were once the scion of a wealthy family who lost their entire fortune in the blink of an eye.

name: Waterdhavian Noble

tool_proficiencies.name: One type of gaming set or musical instrument

equipment.item: a skin of fine zzar or wine

feature_description: In Waterdeep or elsewhere in the North, your house sees to your everyday needs, with establishments recording your debt and sending an accounting to your family's estate. This covers the 2 gp a day for a comfortable lifestyle, or reduces the cost of a wealthy or aristocratic lifestyle by that amount. It is a line of credit, not income.

one trinket (rolled on the Feywild Trinkets table)

feature_description: The Witchlight Carnival provides you with free, modest lodging and food. You may also wander the carnival and partake of its wonders at no cost, provided you don't disrupt its shows or cause trouble.

name: Witherbloom Student
feature_description: You gain the Strixhaven Initiate feat and must choose Witherbloom within it. If you have Spellcasting or Pact Magic, the Witherbloom spells (1st: Cure Wounds, Inflict Wounds; 2nd: Lesser Restoration, Wither and Bloom; 3rd: Revivify, Vampiric Touch; 4th: Blight, Death Ward; 5th: Antilife Shell, Greater Restoration) are added to your class spell list.

name: Simic Scientist

equipment.item: a flask of oil (made from blubber)
a glass bottle of unidentified slime
and a belt pouch containing 10 gp (Azorius 1-zino coins)

feature_description: When you attempt to learn or recall a magical or scientific fact you don't know, you know where and from whom you can obtain it (usually a Simic laboratory, or sometimes an Izzet facility, library, university, or scholar). You might need to offer bribes, favors, or incentives, and the DM might rule the knowledge is inaccessible or can't be found.
